name: player_handle_alt_weapon_bank_select_input
description: Player::HandleAltWeaponBankSelectInput maps bank-select commands to alt weapon banks, gates unavailable or empty weapons, commits accepted alt weapon switches, and refreshes the selected weapon HUD display.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to a coherent Player weapon/source-cluster pass; this target records functional behavior for the input callback and switch handoff.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x439260 validates the altGunTransitionState == 1 gate, command code to bank-index mapping, same-bank side toggle probing, different-bank selected-side probing, availability/ammo rejection, submarine-incompatible weapon rejection, HUD messages, ApplyAltWeaponSwitch handoff, and final active-controller HUD refresh.

The native smoke verifies a different-bank selected-side success path updates the active alt controller, selected bank state, cached alt selection, SFX handoff, and weapon HUD image/text, then verifies a same-bank empty alternate side is rejected without changing the active controller or replaying the switch SFX.
